My work here is done. Summary for you:

## Spend-gate fix: landed

Commit `af32da55` in the `token-reduction` worktree (`C:\Code\lew42\worktrees\token-reduction`, branch `worktree/token-reduction`). Not merged — reporting back to the parent (mastermind-token-reduction), as my brief asked.

**What changed, in `Servex/agents/Agents.js`, `Servex/cards/Cards.js`, `Servex/agents/tools.js`:**
- The Continue/Stop card on a gated agent now actually does something: `gate_check()` tells the ask who it's for and what kind it is, and `Cards.js`'s `wake()` acts on that answer directly (grants $5 or stops the agent) instead of texting the wrong agents a line nobody reads.
- `spawn_agent` can now take a `budget_usd` dollar cap.

**A blocker I hit and resolved myself:** the spend-gate mechanism these two fixes sit on top of (`gate_check`, `meter`, `grant`, etc.) wasn't actually committed anywhere — it only existed as uncommitted edits in the main checkout. I confirmed it was the same base commit as my worktree, checked it applied with zero overlap with the sibling minion's edit to the same file, and brought it in before building on it. Logged as a decision in the task log.

**Proof:** new `Servex/agents/spend-gate-proof.mjs`, 16/16 passing, no live Claude calls. Confirmed `wake-proof.mjs`, `revive-guard-proof.mjs`, and `Servex/cards/test.mjs` all still pass — no regressions.

**Left for later (named, not dropped):** pricing a Claude agent's spend mid-turn, and the Sessions-grid UI column — both out of this fence, noted in the task log.

Everything in my fence is clean (no uncommitted diffs) and I didn't leave any processes running from my own proof runs. Task complete.

## Summary for the parent

**Both deliverables in the `minion-revive-reap` brief are done.**

1. **The provider-on-revive bug (item 6)** — the fix (add `"provider"` to `Agents.js`'s `reopen()` fallback `keys` array) is confirmed present in HEAD. I didn't need to commit it myself: this worktree is shared with `minion-spend-gate`, and my edit got swept into *their* commit before I staged anything (verified with `git show HEAD:Servex/agents/Agents.js` and `git reflog`, which shows them amending their own commit twice while I worked). I added a fast, no-process unit scene to `Servex/agents/revive-proof.mjs` that proves the fix directly: a legacy row with no `spec` keeps `provider: "openrouter"` through `reopen()` — **PASS**.

2. **Landed-task reaping (item 1/3)** — new `Servex/agents/landed-reap-proof.mjs`, 5/5 cases pass. `Lifecycle.why()` already correctly flags an idle minion to close once its *parent mastermind's* task has landed, even when the minion's own `task.jsonl` never got its own `landed_at` line. No bug found, so the regression test is the deliverable, as the brief allows.

**Commit:** `2abb23a587133cdc0d46da8fe8be05e64958242f` in `C:\Code\lew42\worktrees\token-reduction` (two files: the `revive-proof.mjs` scene and the new `landed-reap-proof.mjs`).

**Worth knowing before merge:** this worktree is actively shared with `minion-spend-gate`, which was amending its own commit concurrently. Nothing of mine was lost, but the parent should double-check the merge picks up both minions' work correctly rather than assuming one clean linear history.

Full detail and the proof output are logged in `task.jsonl`.
